description: List the static catalog of PLC vendors and project file formats supported by DS Studio's local PLC reverse-engineering pipeline (first release: LS ELECTRIC XG5000 .xgwx to DS2 v2 and IDTA 01005 v3.0.1 AASX). Filter the catalog with optional vendor, extension, or filter parameters (equivalent aliases: vendorHint, ext, query, q). Use to check supported PLC formats before running local .xgwx conversion in DS Studio (/play) or Local MCP; this public endpoint is read-only and does not ingest PLC files, and differs from dsdx.library.search (3D models) and dsdx.scene.catalog (3D providers).

filter.description: Substring filter on vendor or format name

name: dsdx.plc.formats

error.description: Structured error payload when status != OK
